name: v3 7% line, real money, $150 pilot
status: FROZEN. Do not edit. Any change needs a new file and a new hash pinned in server/live/kalshi-pilot.js PILOT_SHA256 and test/kalshi-pilot.test.js.
source: Bryan, 2026-11-01: 'Ok time to set up live trading with Kalshi using the strategies v1 - v3'; pilot bankroll $100 total; go live with v3 only; 'I want it to be the 7% version'. 2026-11-01 (p2): $150 in the MAIN Kalshi account, use the full amount, no subaccount; reuse the desk's existing Kalshi key. Arming needs a separate message from Bryan and a typed phrase on the desk machine.
money: integer cents for limits; Kalshi amounts parsed exactly to integer micro-dollars
bankrollRule: hard cap: bankroll = min(real Kalshi balance + the pilot's own open cost, bankrollCents + realized pilot P&L); money above it in the account is never counted or spent
account: main account (no subaccount): balance checks compare only the pilot's own fills and fees, never the absolute balance; other positions and orders are not managed, counted or cancelled
dailyStopNote: OFF so live stays comparable with paper v3 (the paper arms have no daily stop). Code and tests exist; switching on (e.g. 1000 and true) needs a new file and hash.
dailyBudgetSizing: when shrinkToDailyBudget is true and a daily stop is set: before each slice, the worst-case loss (cost + fee if the contract settles NO) of the new contracts plus today's realized loss plus today's open worst-case must stay within the daily stop; size down, or skip if under 1 contract
totalLossStop: permanent HALT; cleared only by a manual reset file data/live/kalshi-pilot/RESET_TOTAL_STOP plus the localhost reset phrase

order.hold: to settlement; the pilot never sells

fees.formula: per order: ceil_to_cent(0.07 * C * P * (1 - P)); real fees always come from Kalshi fill data
